jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Mount Ascutney School District, a unified union district in the Windsor Southeast Supervisory Union (member towns: Windsor, West Windsor). Operates PK-12.

sources.note: Mount Ascutney SD: six directors, residency allocated Windsor 3 / West Windsor 3, elected by the voters of both towns (modified at-large "Hybrid Model"). NO memberships are minted: the newest fetched official roster is the March 13, 2023 board agenda (Burrows, McMullen, McGraw, Roisman, Yates, Pedrick) and the board has since turned over -- only Bill Yates is corroborated as current by a 2026 official document (Act 170 committee minutes, October 14, 2026), and the March 2026 re-election-and-resignation of Amy McMullen plus the pending appointment to her seat are known only from news leads. Resolving documents: the board's March-May 2026 minutes on wsesu.net and the adopted 2017 Articles of Agreement. Town of West Windsor Selectboard minutes, May 11, 2017 (official): the Articles of Agreement discussion for the merger records the board design -- "3 Windsor and 3 West Windsor members, but they would have to be voted on by both towns" (the "Hybrid Model") -- the 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large pattern. The district's 2021 Annual Report lists six "Mount Ascutney School Board Directors" (3 Windsor + 3 West Windsor by address). The adopted 2017 Articles of Agreement themselves were not located.
